differential.name: Acute non‑ST segment elevation myocardial infarction (NSTEMI)
differential.rationale: Current active cardiac event with prior MI, hypertension, metabolic syndrome and high LDL.

differential.name: Chronic kidney disease secondary to hypertension and diabetes
differential.rationale: Prior creatinine 2.7 mg/dL (high), current GFR likely reduced, anemia and metabolic syndrome support CKD.

differential.name: Atherosclerotic coronary artery disease (stable ischemic heart disease)
differential.rationale: Long‑standing risk factors (HTN, dyslipidemia, obesity, smoking/alcohol) predispose to underlying CAD beyond the acute NSTEMI.

differential.name: Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD)
differential.rationale: Metabolic syndrome, elevated ALT (38 U/L), high triglyceride‑laden profile, modest alcohol use.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Presence of chronic inflammation (CKD, CAD, chronic pain) with mild anemia noted in history.
